'''Phosflare''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Glowfly]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies, and evolves into [[Glimmerwing]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "A performer who takes every moment seriously. Phosflare refuses to fight without a personal soundtrack and custom lighting. Currently researching how to get vibrant shimmer effects from the color black."

Phosflare is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A teal blue firefly with an electrically-charged, glowing lower abdomen. Its face is light beige, and it has yellow antennae shaped like lightning bolts. It has pink blush and there's a small green circle on each of its wing casings which are orange at the edges. Its sclera are yellow and its pupils are green.

Phosflare's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter Form]] changes the color of its body and irises from teal to purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Phosflare's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Glimmerwing]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Phosflare to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x2000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod 2000x).

== Trivia ==
* Phosflare and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/1/2026 alongside [[Umbraveil]] and [[Hierotyrus]].
